score.rationale: This proposal is exceptionally well-defined, scoring near-perfectly across all dimensions. It presents a highly specific, measurable problem: proving the storage round-trip for a `WorkerEvaluationRecord` before further development. The scope is surgically precise, with explicit goals and non-goals that prevent scope creep and focus effort on the core risk. Acceptance criteria are concrete and directly testable, outlining the exact behavior of the required integration test. The proposal demonstrates deep technical awareness by referencing existing systems, constraints (`@kbn/evals`), and a clear risk-mitigation strategy (the contract-seam stop condition). Finally, its linkage to a specific feature spike (`daybreak-s1-alert-analysis-worker-spike`) provides excellent traceability, ensuring the work is contextualized within the broader product lifecycle. The only minor deduction is for the lack of explicit edge case definition in the acceptance criteria, though the deterministic nature of the single test makes this less critical.
